summary: Fade-out of a status visual on the client: an entity handle, the current opacity and the fade speed (1 / fade time). Added by the status visual state machine bg3.exe+0x1BF6060 (state 4 -> 5) and run by the per-frame update of ecl::statusVisual::FadeSystem (bg3.exe+0x1A55070, query FadeComponent + ls::VisualComponent), which lowers the opacity each frame and destroys the visual when it drops to 1/256. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (client row). The savegame model game.crowds.v0.FadeComponent matched by short name belongs to a crowds component, not to this one.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1BF6D20 (AllocRaw 0x10) writes 0xFFC0000000000000 (null handle) at +0. bg3.exe+0x1BF6060 writes `*p = *param_2` (an entity handle passed in by the status visual code). Which entity (visual owner vs. status) is not established.

fields.name: Opacity
fields.evidence: Creator writes dword 0 at +8. bg3.exe+0x1BF6060 writes the float at +0x30 of the status visual (only when >= 1/256). FadeSystem update bg3.exe+0x1A55070: `v = *(float*)(p+8) - GameTime.DeltaTime(+8) * *(float*)(p+0xC); if (v > 0.00390625) { *(float*)(p+8) = v; apply } else remove`.

fields.name: FadeSpeed
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0x3F800000 (1.0f) at +0xC. bg3.exe+0x1BF6060 writes `1.0 / *(float*)(settings + 0x4C)` (1 / fade duration); the update multiplies DeltaTime by it.
